```{python}
#| label: fig-pca-counties
#| fig-cap: "Two-dimensional principal component projection of U.S. counties using the top two principal components of geographic and demographic features, with color indicating logged data center count."
plt.figure(figsize=(7, 5))
scatter = plt.scatter(
    X_train[:, 0],
    X_train[:, 1],
    c=y_train,
    cmap='viridis',
    edgecolors='none',
    s=20,
    alpha=0.3
)
plt.xlabel('Principal Component 1')
plt.ylabel('Principal Component 2')
plt.title('PCA Projection of US Counties by Logged Datacenter Count')
plt.colorbar(scatter, label='Logged Datacenter Count')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
